info.title: HaiTouWang Cloud API
info.description: Contract-first API for profile, job, material, review, local agent, application and lifecycle domains. Raw target-site credentials, cookies and CAPTCHA values are forbidden in every cloud request.

servers.description: Production placeholder; region remains a product decision

tags.name: Facts
tags.description: Versioned, scoped and attributable user facts.

tags.name: Materials
tags.description: Resumes, letters, answers and their fact citations.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Imported, normalized, deduplicated and risk-assessed jobs.

tags.name: Scores
tags.description: Deterministic match dimensions and hard gates.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Local-agent pairing, authorization and command protocol.

post.x-idempotency: required; same principal, operation and normalized request replay the first response

get.summary: List facts in the authenticated tenant

201.description: Fact created pending confirmation unless explicitly user-confirmed

get.summary: List generated or uploaded material metadata

post.summary: Approve a material after a server-side Review gate
post.description: The authenticated principal supplies no tenant identity. The server reads the persisted Review and material in one consistency boundary and rejects missing, stale, non-approved, or open must-fix Reviews.

post.summary: Reject a material with an audited server-side transition
Import a Greenhouse, Lever, company Careers or manual URL
post.x-idempotency: required; canonical URL is also a business dedupe key

get.summary: List deterministic scores and hard-gate decisions

post.summary: Resolve a Review finding before material approval

post.x-idempotency: required; replay returns the same still-valid session and does not reveal a rotated secret

201.description: One-time pairing material; pairing_secret is returned only in this response

post.summary: Claim a pairing session with device proof of possession
post.x-idempotency: required; security replay records remain independently enforced

202.description: Claim accepted and awaiting authenticated user confirmation

post.summary: Confirm the displayed device and bind it to the user

200.description: Pairing confirmed; authorization code is one-time and short-lived

post.summary: Exchange a one-time authorization code or rotate a device-bound refresh token
post.x-idempotency: required; refresh-token reuse revokes the entire authorization family

200.description: Short-lived access token and rotated refresh token

Cache-Control.description: Token responses must not be cached.

post.summary: Claim one scoped command with a bounded lease
post.x-idempotency: required; command nonce and token jti are also replay-protected

post.summary: Report redacted agent health and renew an eligible lease
Revoke an agent authorization and cancel queued work

post.x-idempotency: required; submission_idempotency_key has an independent unique constraint

post.summary: Apply one legal application state transition

409.description: Rejected illegal transition or idempotency conflict

rejected.summary: Submission rejected because current state is not confirmable

error.message: The requested transition is not allowed from the current state.

422.description: Automation stopped and requires explicit human action

error.message: A user answer is required before this application can continue.

get.summary: List interview rounds with UTC and IANA time zone

post.summary: Create a tentative or user-confirmed interview
post.x-idempotency: required; source reference is also used for deduplication

get.summary: List versioned metric points with sample size

200.description: Cursor page of redacted audit events

UserBearer.description: Short-lived SaaS user access token; tenant is derived from the authenticated principal.

AgentBearer.description: Five-minute device-bound agent token with least-privilege scope claims. Every request also carries proof of possession and a replay-protected nonce.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to tenant, filters, ordering and API major version.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one business intent. Same key plus a different normalized request is rejected.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Caller-provided UUID for end-to-end correlation; server generates one when absent.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag containing the expected resource version.

AgentRequestNonce.name: X-Agent-Nonce
AgentRequestNonce.description: Single-use random nonce bound into X-Agent-Proof.

AgentProof.name: X-Agent-Proof
AgentProof.description: Base64url device signature over method, path, timestamp, nonce and request body digest.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: True when this is the stored response for an earlier identical request.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds before a rate-limited request may be retried.

Error.description: Error response using a stable machine code

BadRequest.description: Validation failed or forbidden credential-class data was supplied

Forbidden.description: Tenant, policy or token scope forbids the action

NotFound.description: Resource not found in the authenticated tenant

Conflict.description: Version, unique key, idempotency key or state transition conflict

PreconditionFailed.description: Explicit confirmation or verified evidence is required

ReplayDetected.description: Token jti, challenge, authorization code, command nonce or request nonce was already consumed

PairingRejected.description: Pairing material is invalid, expired, revoked or already consumed

error.message: The pairing session cannot be claimed.

ManualIntervention.description: The command stopped safely and requires user action

public_key_jwk.description: P-256 public-only JWK. The private member d is structurally rejected.

payload.description: Reference-only command payload. Credentials, cookies, CAPTCHA values, arbitrary form content and executable scripts are structurally excluded.

confirmation_token.description: Required only for submit_application; bound to user, agent, application, command and preview hash.
